approval_source.question_set: The root kit drill on the staging hosts: which control, which notice, who signs, when

reason: staging.kits.drill needs three of five rehearsal kits to prepare, sign and submit a root control end to end on the staging hosts. The kit replacement drill (K4) is approved for the CI staging network only (P01_E05_KIT_REPLACEMENT_DRILL_2026-10-08), which leaves 'a replacement drill on real hosts with the full notice' unset, and staging_network.py kit-drill has no real-host mode.

decisions.question: Which control the drill runs
decisions.rule: Each control is made with the release tools from the dytallix-staging-2 rehearsal kits and submitted over the sentry's client channel; admission with 3 of 5 signatures is the pass.

decisions.question: Who signs
decisions.selected: The founder signs, using the 3 rehearsal kits
decisions.rule: Only rehearsal kits; never production kits or fobs.

accepted_risks: The staging chain is frozen between the freeze and the resume.
unset: Which notice a kit replacement uses: none runs under this record (the control is freeze then resume); a kit replacement drill on real hosts needs its own answer
Tooling: build a real-host kit drill driver and staging summarizer first, or run the release tools by hand and record
When: the drill's UTC window (a freeze halts the staging chain until its resume is admitted)
does_not_authorize: any production kit, fob or key
any upgrade or handover on a real host (T8 has its own approval)
any change to who may sign a replacement, its notice or its scope in production
